in_scope.name: Kumar
in_scope.other_work: I collect the sales numbers from our family's three stalls every week. I clean up the spreadsheet so the dates and amounts are consistent. I make charts that show which items sell best in which month. I look at the numbers to spot which stall is losing money. I present what I find to my parents every month.

in_scope.name: Wei Ling
in_scope.other_work: I look after the computers at my church office. I install the software they need and keep it updated. I set up the office wifi and the shared printer. When something stops working I find out why and fix it. I showed the volunteers how to use the new email system.

in_scope.name: Izzat
in_scope.other_work: I write small programs in Python to automate my friend's online shop. I built a web page where customers can check their order status. out_of_scope.name: Aina
out_of_scope.other_work: I cut and style hair for neighbours from my house. I wash and condition their hair before cutting. I buy shampoo and colour from a supplier every month. I collect payment by cash or DuitNow after each customer.

out_of_scope.name: Mei
out_of_scope.other_work: I sew baju kurung for customers before Raya. I measure each customer so the clothes fit. I cut the fabric from my own patterns. I work out the price from the cost of the fabric and my time. I keep a notebook of every order and payment.

out_of_scope.name: Hakim
out_of_scope.other_work: I repair motorcycles for people in my kampung on weekends. I check the bike to find out what is wrong. I order spare parts from a shop in town. I tell the owner how much the repair will cost before I start. I write down what I charged in a book.

out_of_scope.name: Siva
out_of_scope.other_work: I give tuition in Mathematics to secondary school students. I mark their homework and exam practice. I talk to the parents about how their children are doing. I collect the monthly fees and keep a list of who has paid.

out_of_scope.name: Rahman
out_of_scope.other_work: I drive for e-hailing in the evenings. I take passengers to the airport and around the city. I keep my car serviced and clean. I track my fuel, tolls and earnings each week to see what I really make.

out_of_scope.name: Nurul
out_of_scope.other_work: I care for an elderly neighbour three afternoons a week. I help her bathe and get dressed. I prepare her meals. I buy her groceries and medicine and keep the receipts for her son.

out_of_scope.name: Zul
out_of_scope.other_work: I grow chillies and vegetables on my father's land. I plant the seedlings and harvest the crops. I sell the vegetables at the pasar tani every Saturday. I set the prices depending on what other sellers charge. I keep track of how much we sell each week.

out_of_scope.name: Daniel
out_of_scope.other_work: I run a nasi lemak stall at the morning market. I cook the rice, sambal and chicken before dawn. I plan the menu and decide the price of each set. I buy the ingredients in bulk and keep track of the stock. I count the cash at the end of each day.
